lines.japanese:
「昨夜はよくお眠りになられましたか？
　慣れないお屋敷の夜でしたから、色々と不具合がないかって心配していたんですけど」
「ああ、とりあえず困るようなコトはないよ。
これでも昔はここに住んでいたんだし、今はちゃんと気を配ってくれる琥珀さんがいるし」
「あら。
お上手ですね、志貴さん」
「えっ？
　いや、たんに思ったことを口にしただけど……お上手って、なにが上手なんですか？」
　琥珀さんは笑顔のままこっちを眺めているだけだ。
　……なんていうか、そうまっすぐに見られると照れくさくて、視線をよそに移す。
lines.label: s123
lines.maoEnglish:
“Did you sleep well? It was your first night in an unfamiliar estate, so I was worried something might not suit you.”
“Nothing’s given me any trouble so far. I did live here once, after all—and now I have you looking after me so thoughtfully.”
“My, how smooth of you, Shiki.”
“What? I only said what I was thinking… Smooth at what, exactly?”
Kohaku merely keeps smiling at me.
Having her look at me so directly is embarrassing somehow, and I turn my eyes away.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Did you sleep well last night?

Kohaku-san just looks at me, smiling.
…… Somehow, I feel embarrassed when she looks directly at me, so I shift my gaze to the side.

―――と。
　さっきから無言でこっちを見つめている、もう一つの視線に気がついた。
「あ……よお」
　軽く手をあげて挨拶をする。
　秋葉はじっとこっちを見つめてくる。
……っていうか、睨んできてる。
lines.label: s123

I notice another pair of eyes that has been silently fixed on me all this time.
“Oh—hey.”
I raise one hand in a casual greeting.
Akiha keeps staring at me. No, she is glaring.

「あら、無理に挨拶をしてくれなくてもいいのに。

「うっ……」
　秋葉の言葉はちくちくする。
　……こっちだって別に秋葉のことを無視していたわけじゃなくて、ただ琥珀さんに挨拶をしただけなんだけど……。

“Oh, you needn’t force yourself to greet me. Please, feel free to ignore me. You clearly prefer beginning your morning with Kohaku.”
“Urgh…”
Akiha’s words prick like needles.
I had not meant to ignore Akiha; I simply greeted Kohaku first.

“He hasn’t eaten because he rose too late. If his morning is rushed, he has no one but himself to blame.”
Akiha gives a disdainful little sniff.
Apparently she resented both my arriving at this hour and my failure to greet her.

その頃、屋敷は大きな遊び場だった。
　深い森のような庭。
　高い城のような家。
　何日かかっても探険しきれない閉じた箱庭の世界で、ボクたちは遊びまわった。

A house as tall as a castle.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: In Shiki's repeated childhood memory, Akiha is always behind him; when he waves to her, she grows shy and hides. mirror moon assigns both actions to Akiha, so she waves and then hides. The agency reversal recurs across all four cited route instances and changes the small ritual through which Shiki recalls reaching out to his sister.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: Shiki waving to Akiha becomes Akiha waving and hiding

I froze in horror.
From the familiar Arima estate I could reach school in twenty minutes, but from here I did not even know the shortcuts.

“Damn it, if she was going to wake me, she could at least have done it earlier…!”

It had been arranged perfectly, and even the shirt was freshly pressed.
Sliding my arms into the sleeves felt almost as good as putting on something new.

I knew my old man hated me for some reason and that once I had been entrusted to the Arimas, I would never go back home…… Go back to the Tohno mansion, that is.
That's why, well, I thought I'd just continue to live as a son of the Arimas forever.
That's what I thought, but my old man kicked the bucket recently.
That's when they told me to return to the mansion, now that my old man is no longer there, and I finally agreed."

「そうですね。
俺は自分の父親になんでか嫌われてまして、有間の家に預けられた時から二度と自分の家……遠野の屋敷に戻ることはないって解ってたんです。
　だからまあ、自分としては有間の家の子供として暮らしていこうってずっと思ってた。
　思ってたんですけど、つい最近その父親が他界したんです。
　……そうなると屋敷には妹一人しかいませんから。
長い間放っておいてしまったこともあるし、いまさらですけど屋敷に戻ることにしたんです」

A father and mother who weren’t truly mine.
An unfamiliar house that should have belonged to strangers.
But none of that mattered—

lines.maoEnglish:
“Why? The victims had all the blood drained from their bodies, so calling the killer a vampire seems obvious.”
“Do you know the old stories about vampires?”
Ciel abruptly smiled and asked an even stranger question.
“You mean the story that anyone bitten by a vampire becomes one too?”
“Yes. In that case, no corpse would remain. If a vampire were responsible, there would be no bodies to discover.”
“That makes sense, but vampire is only a nickname. You don’t actually believe they exist, do you?”
“Of course not. If a body is left behind, then it wasn’t a vampire, was it?”
Still smiling, Ciel offered this curiously misplaced conclusion.
“But couldn’t you look at it this way?
The bodies being found belong to people who died because they failed to become vampires.
Some people can become one and some cannot. Those who can are never discovered as corpses after an attack, because they are still alive somewhere.
Those who cannot simply die, and so they are found.”

"Not at all.
After all, the fact that the bodies are there show that it's not a vampire, right?"

"But couldn't you also think of it this way?
Maybe the victims whose bodies have been found died because they couldn't become vampires.
Perhaps there are those who can be turned, and those who can't.
The people who can become vampires won't have their corpses found even if they were attacked by vampires.
Because even now, they're still alive--out there somewhere.
But those who can't become vampires just die, and so their bodies wind up being found."

lines.label: s214
lines.maoEnglish:
“I still have work to complete, so please excuse me.”
Her footsteps clicking briskly, Hisui entered Akiha’s bedroom.
“Mm.”
However bored I might be, I could hardly follow her into a girl’s room.
“No choice—I’ll go back.”
I turned away.
Before I did, I remembered the window where Hisui had been standing.
“Ah―――is that Kohaku in the courtyard?”
The window overlooked the entire courtyard.
Had Hisui been watching it from here, just as that girl had when we were children?

―――それじゃあね。
ばいばい、遠野くん。
　それは、どこにでもあるさよならのセリフ。
　……本当に幸せそうだった、柔らかな笑顔。
　あんな顔をするヤツが家出なんかするわけがない。
―――ピンチの時は助けてね、遠野くん。
　そう、こんな事をしている理由なんて単純だ。
　俺はただ、あの時の笑顔が裏切れないだけなんだから――――
lines.label: s216
lines.maoEnglish:
―――See you, then. Bye, Tohno.
It was an ordinary goodbye, the sort heard anywhere.
The soft smile she wore had looked so genuinely happy.
Someone who could smile like that wouldn’t run away from home.
―――Help me if I’m ever in trouble, Tohno.
Yes―――the reason I was doing this was simple.
I simply couldn’t betray the smile she’d given me then――――

　見つけられっこないんだから、いいかげん屋敷に戻ろう。
「……く……そ……」
　だっていうのに、まだ街のほうを見て回ろうと踵を返した。
lines.label: s216
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hah―――hah――――hah―――”
There was no one resembling Yumizuka in the park either.
I could never have found someone without a single lead to begin with.
I wasn’t going to find her, so I ought to return to the estate.
“Damn―――it―――”
And yet I turned back toward town to search a little longer.

lines.japanese:
もう一度駅前にやってくる。
　時刻は夜の九時をすぎてしまっている。
　連日の通り魔殺人のせいか、まだ九時だっていうのに人通りは極めて少ない。
――――と。
「弓――――塚」
　一瞬、自分の目を疑った。
　けど目の前で歩いている後ろ姿は、弓塚さつきに似すぎていた。
lines.label: s216
lines.maoEnglish:
I returned to the station once more.
It was already past nine.
Perhaps because of the recent random street killings, there were remarkably few people out even though it was only nine.
――――And then.
“Yumi――――zuka”
For an instant I doubted my eyes.
But the figure walking ahead of me looked too much like Satsuki Yumizuka.

　……遠くて、よくわからない。
　見間違いかもしれないけど、とにかく追いついて呼びとめよう、と走った。
「待って、弓塚さん―――！」
　追いかけながら声をかける。
lines.label: s216
lines.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka drifted unsteadily through the crowd.
She was too far away to see clearly.
I might have been mistaken, but I ran after her to catch up and call her back.
“Wait, Yumizuka―――!”
I called out as I chased her.

Perhaps she heard me, because Yumizuka glanced back over her shoulder.
There was nothing remarkable about her face.
The girl ahead of me was unmistakably Satsuki Yumizuka, and she wasn’t wearing any frightening expression.

　なのに、ぞくりとした悪寒を感じてしまった。

「なんだろう……なんか、ヘンだ」
　体中が熱い。
　質の悪い熱病にうかされたみたいに、クラクラする。
　そうしている間に、弓塚はまた歩き出してしまった。

lines.maoEnglish:
“――――Ah”
Even so, a chill ran through me.
―――Thump.
My heart quickened.
The back of my head grew dizzy and heavy, and my throat grew faintly warm.
“Something―――something feels wrong.”
My whole body burned.
I reeled as though delirious with a vicious fever.
While I stood there, Yumizuka began walking again.

I called as I ran.
Without looking back, she kept walking unsteadily.
“D―――damn it, can’t you hear me, Yumizuka……!”
I forced my feverish body to keep running.
But no matter what I did, I could not catch her.
However fast I ran, I could not catch up with Yumizuka even though she was only walking.

Yumizuka’s back suddenly vanished.
Until then, her back had remained in sight even though I could not catch up, but now it was nowhere to be seen.

My chest heaved as I panted.
I had not noticed until now, but I seemed to have been running for a very long time.
“What time is it―――?”
Bracing both hands on my knees, I looked toward a nearby shop window.
The time was―――almost midnight.

I had chased her for nearly three hours and called to her again and again without so much as a glance back; what was she thinking?

Its fingers pierce my shoulder.
lines.mirror_moon:
Rip.
Its fingers pierce my shoulder.

lines.japanese:
「っっっっっ！」
　痛みで体が跳ねる。
　ソレの指は、鋭いキリのようだった。
　容赦なく俺の皮をさいて肉をえぐり、そのまま神経を引きずっていく激痛―――
「あ、ああ、あ――――！」
　ただ痛くて、そんな声しか出せない。
　悲鳴をあげながら懸命にソイツを引き剥がすが、ソイツの力は強すぎた。
俺が何をしようがびくともしない。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――!”
My body jerked with pain.
Its fingers were sharp as awls.
They sliced mercilessly through my skin, gouged into my flesh, and dragged raw pain through every nerve―――
“Ah, aaah――――!”
The pain left me capable of nothing but that cry.
Screaming, I fought to wrench it away, but it was monstrously strong. Nothing I did moved it an inch.
lines.mao_english:
“―――――!”
My body jerked with pain.
Its fingers were sharp as awls.
They sliced mercilessly through my skin, gouged into my flesh, and dragged raw pain through every nerve―――
“Ah, aaah――――!”
The pain left me capable of nothing but that cry.
Screaming, I fought to wrench it away, but it was monstrously strong. Nothing I did moved it an inch.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Chhh!"
My body arcs from pain.
The fingers were like a sharp needle.
It shreds my skin mercilessly, scooping out nerves and flesh as it goes---
"Ah, aahhh----!"
The pain is so great that I can say nothing else.
Though I try to tear him off me screaming, he is too strong.
Whatever I do, he does not move.

lines.japanese:
カカ、と音をたててシャレコウベの口が開く。
　肩を一口で噛み砕けるぐらいに開いた口が、死にたくない、と助けをこうように、俺の顔へと近寄ってくる。
「や――――」
　やめろ、という声も通じない。
　骨と皮だけのソイツは、そのまま俺の頭にかじりつこうとして――――そのまま、唐突に、崩れ落ちた。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
Its jaws clacked open, wide enough to crush my shoulder in one bite.
That mouth came toward my face as if pleading for help—as if begging not to die.
“St—”
It could not understand me telling it to stop.
The thing of bone and skin lunged to bite into my skull—and then, without warning, collapsed.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
With a creak, the skull's jaw opens.
The mouth opens wide enough to rip off my shoulder with a single bite, and he approaches my face as if saying, "I don't want to die, somebody save me".
"St---"
I can't even say "stop".
The guy made only of skin and bones, tries to bite my head----and suddenly, he collapses.

lines.japanese:
「へ……？」
　あんなに強かった力が消えていく。
　かろうじて骨と皮だけが残っていた人の形をしたソイツは、残された骨と皮さえも無くして、跡形もなく消え去っていく。
　さらさらと。
　悪い夢みたいに、ソレは灰になって散っていった。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Huh…?”
Its terrible strength ebbed away.
The thing had barely retained a human shape in bone and skin; now even those remnants vanished, leaving nothing behind.
Softly, grain by grain.
It crumbled into ash and scattered like a nightmare breaking apart.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Eh…?"
The awesome power vanishes.
The bag of bones in a person's form crumples to the ground and disappears.
Softly,
like a bad dream, it turns to ash and blows away.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「………なんだよ、これ」
　ずきりと、肩から痛みが走る。
「あ………つ」
　背中に自分の血が流れていく。
　痛みは現実。
だからこれは、紛れもない現実。
　ひどい、悪夢だ。
　こんなコト―――悪い夢でしかないのに、夢ですら、ないなんて。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“…What the hell was that?”
Pain stabbed through my shoulder.
“Ah…
ngh.”
My own blood ran down my back.
The pain was real, and therefore this was real.
A hideous nightmare—something that could only be a bad dream, yet wasn’t even a dream.

"Ach…"
My own blood flows down my back.
The pain is real.
So this must be real.
A terrible nightmare.
But---it can't be a nightmare, because it's not a dream.

lines.japanese:
「遠野くん。
それ以上そこにいると危ないよ」
「――――！」
　背後からの声に振りかえる。
　入ってきた路地裏の入り口に、弓塚さつきが立っていた。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Tohno. It’s dangerous to stay there.”
“――――!”
I spun toward the voice behind me.
Satsuki Yumizuka stood at the entrance to the alley.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Tohno-kun.
It'll be dangerous if you stay there."
"----!"
I turn towards the voice behind me.
At the mouth of the alley where I came from, I see Yumizuka Satsuki.

lines.japanese:
「弓、塚―――？」
「こんばんは。
こんなところで会うなんて、奇遇だね」
　まるで、街中で偶然であったように、気軽に弓塚は語りかけてきた。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka―――?”
“Good evening. Fancy meeting you in a place like this.”
Yumizuka spoke as lightly as though we had bumped into each other on an ordinary street.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka---?"
"Good evening.
Fancy meeting you in a place like this, huh?"
As if we had merely bumped into each other in the mall, Yumizuka greets me lightheartedly.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「弓塚、おまえ……おまえこそ、こんな時間に何してるんだよ」
「わたしはただの散歩。
でも、遠野くんこそ何をしてるの？
　そんなにいっぱいの人を殺しちゃうなんて、いけないんじゃないかな」
　ふふ、と淡い笑顔で弓塚は言った。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka, you―――what are you doing out at this hour?”
“I’m only taking a walk. What are you doing, Tohno? Killing so many people is rather naughty, don’t you think?”
Yumizuka gave a faint, soft laugh.
lines.mao_english:
“Yumizuka, you―――what are you doing out at this hour?”

Yumizuka gave a faint, soft laugh.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka, you… What are you doing, out at a time like this?"
"Oh, just going for a walk.
But what's Tohno-kun doing?
Killing so many people like this is bad, right?"
Yumizuka says, with a light smile.

lines.japanese:
「人を殺したって―――え？」
　周囲を見渡す。
　……それで、自分がどんな惨状の中で立ち尽くしているのかを思い出した。
　一面の血の海の中。
　遠野志貴は、まるで殺人犯のように、呆然と立ち尽くしている。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Killing people―――what?”
I looked around.
Then I remembered the carnage in which I stood.
I stood in the middle of a sea of blood.
Shiki Tohno stood frozen there like the murderer himself.
lines.mao_english:
“Killing people―――what?”
I looked around.
Then I remembered the carnage in which I stood.
I stood in the middle of a sea of blood.
Shiki Tohno stood frozen there like the murderer himself.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Killing so many people… eh?"
I look around me.
…… And I remember the tragic scene I'm surrounded by.
In a sea of blood.
Tohno Shiki stands aghast like a murderer.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Killing so many people… eh?"
I look around me.
…… And I remember the tragic scene I'm surrounded by.
In a sea of blood.

lines.japanese:
「ち、違う、これは俺じゃない……！」
「違うことはないでしょう。
みんな死んでいて、生きてるのは遠野くんだけなら誰だってやったのは遠野くんだって思うわ」
「そんなワケないだろう！
　俺だってコイツに襲われかけたんだぞ……！」
　さっきまで自分を襲っていた怪物を指差す。
　けど、そこにはもう何もない。
　アレは骨はおろか、灰さえものこさずに風に散って消えていた。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“N-no, I didn’t do this!”
“But how could it be anyone else? With everyone dead and you the only one alive, anyone would think you did it.”
“That’s ridiculous! That thing attacked me too!”
I pointed to the creature that had been on top of me.
Nothing was there.
Not even ash remained; it had scattered on the wind and disappeared.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"N… no!
This wasn't me!"
"Oh, of course it was.
Everyone's dead, and Tohno-kun's alive, so obviously Tohno-kun must have killed them."
"No way!
It just attacked me……!"
I point at the monster that attacked me moments ago.
But, nothing's there.
Even the ashes of the bones have been blown away by the wind.

lines.japanese:
「あ――――」
　息を飲む。
　弓塚はくすくすと笑っている。
「ち、ちがう―――俺じゃ、俺じゃない、んだ」
　あたまがマヒして、そんな言葉しか言えない。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah――――”
My breath caught.
Yumizuka giggled.
“N-no―――it wasn’t me, it wasn’t me”
My mind was numb; those were the only words I could produce.
lines.mao_english:
“Ah――――”
My breath caught.
Yumizuka giggled.
“N-no―――it wasn’t me, it wasn’t me”
My mind was numb; those were the only words I could produce.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah----"
I swallow my breath.
Yumizuka is chuckling.
"It's not… this wasn't… wasn't me…"
My head is paralyzed, and can only manage broken language.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Ah----"
I swallow my breath.
Yumizuka is chuckling.
"It's not… this wasn't… wasn't me…"
My head is paralyzed, and can only manage broken language.

lines.japanese:
……わかってる。
　ちゃんと何がおかしくて何がおかしくないのか解っているんだけど、思考が空回りして喋れない。
　例えば、家出しているっていう弓塚がどうしてこんなところにいるのか。
　例えば、こんな惨状を目の前にして、どうして弓塚はそんなふうに笑ってられるのか、とか。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
I understood.
I knew what made sense and what did not, but my thoughts spun uselessly and left me unable to speak.
For instance, why was Yumizuka—supposedly a runaway—here at all?
And how could she smile like that with this carnage before her?
lines.mao_english:

I knew what made sense and what did not, but my thoughts spun uselessly and left me unable to speak.
For instance, why was Yumizuka—supposedly a runaway—here at all?
And how could she smile like that with this carnage before her?
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… I understand.
I can think clearly, but I can't put my thoughts into words.
For example, why is Yumizuka at a place like this after running away from home?
For example, why is Yumizuka laughing in the face of this tragic scene?

lines.japanese:
「弓塚さん、俺は―――」
「うん、ほんとは解ってるんだ。
遠野くんは食事中に出くわしただけなんでしょう？
　いじわるなこと言ってごめんね。
わたし、いつも自分の気持ちと反対のことをしちゃうから、遠野くんにはいつもこんなふうにしてばっかり」
　弓塚はまだ笑っている。
　……それがこの惨状にあまりに不釣り合いで、ぞくりとした。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka, I—” “I know the truth.
You only stumbled across me while I was eating, didn’t you? I’m sorry I teased you. I always do the opposite of what I really feel. Somehow, I’m always like that with you.”
Yumizuka was still smiling.
…The smile was so grotesquely out of place that a chill ran through me.
lines.mao_english:

You only stumbled across me while I was eating, didn’t you? I’m sorry I teased you. I always do the opposite of what I really feel. Somehow, I’m always like that with you.”
Yumizuka was still smiling.
…The smile was so grotesquely out of place that a chill ran through me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka-san, I---"
"Yeah, I know.
You just interrupted someone's meal.
I'm sorry for sounding mean.
I always act against my feelings, so I'm always acting like this to you."
Yumizuka is still laughing.
…… It's so inappropriate for this scene, I feel a chill.

弓塚は路地裏の入り口から動かない。
　不自然に組まれた両腕。
まるで、何かを隠すように後ろに組んでいる。
―――注意して見れば。
　彼女の肘のあたりには赤々としたモノが、まだら模様をつくっていた。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
Yumizuka remained at the entrance.
Her arms were held in an unnatural pose behind her back. It was as if she were hiding something.
―――When I looked closely.
Vivid red stains mottled the skin around her elbows.

「どうしたの？
　恐い顔して、ヘンな遠野くん」
　また、クスリと笑う。
「――――――」
　……違う。
　彼女は、弓塚さつきなんかじゃ、ない。

“What’s wrong? You look frightening, Tohno.”

“――――――”
No.

「弓塚―――なんでおまえ、手を隠してるんだ」
「あ、やっぱりバレちゃった？
　遠野くんってば抜けているようで鋭いんだよね。
わたしね、あなたのそうゆう所が昔っからいいなあって思ってたんだ、志貴くん」
　そう、わざとらしく志貴くん、と強く発音して。
　弓塚は、両手を前にさし出した。
lines.label: s217
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka―――why are you hiding your hands?”
“Oh, you noticed? You act absentminded, but you’re surprisingly sharp. That’s something I’ve always liked about you, Shiki.”
She placed an almost theatrical emphasis on the name Shiki.
Then Yumizuka brought both hands out in front of her.

lines.label: s218
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ee—!”
I recoiled on instinct.
It moved many times faster than I did.
Wheezing, it threw itself on top of me.
――Hhhee… hhhee…
The loathsome sound came from inches away.
A great hole gaped in the creature’s throat; apparently it could no longer form proper words.

throat trembled with each horrible sound.
“Aaaaaah!”

That mouth came toward my face as if pleading for help—as if begging not to die.
“St—” My attempt to say stop meant nothing to it.
The thing of bone and skin lunged to bite into my skull—and then,
without warning, collapsed.

Pain stabbed through my shoulders.
“Ah…!”

Pain was real. So this was unmistakably real too.

Something that could only be a bad dream—and yet was not even a dream.

She spoke as casually as if we had bumped into each other downtown.

　ちゃんと何がおかしくて何がおかしくないのかわかっているんだけど、思考が空回りして喋れない。

My mind was numb; that was all I could say.
I knew.
I could tell perfectly well what made sense and what did not, but my thoughts spun uselessly and left me unable to speak.
For instance: why was Yumizuka here?
And how could she smile like that with this carnage before her?

「なにを―――なにを言ってるんだ、弓塚」
「今はわからなくていいよ。
わたしもまだ自分自身のことを把握しきれてないから、うまく説明できないわ。

lines.maoEnglish:
“I’m sorry. I almost got you caught up in this. I’m so glad that thing died before it could finish changing.”
“What—what are you talking about, Yumizuka?”
“You don’t have to understand yet. I still don’t entirely understand what’s happened to me, so I can’t explain it very well.

Someone like you—a proper murderer—”
Before she could finish, Yumizuka’s face twisted in agony.
“Hah—ah…
ngh…!”
She clawed desperately at her throat, then vomited a thick gush of blood.

lines.japanese:
「あ、どうもありがとうございます。
……けど、秋葉はもう済ませたのか？
　見たところ食後のお茶みたいだけど」
「当然です。
兄さんがどんな時間に起床しようとかまいませんが、せめて朝食ぐらいは余裕をもってください。
七時をすぎて朝食をとるなんて、たるんでいる証拠です」
「……いや、七時ごろに朝食をとるのは普通だと思うけど。
そういう秋葉は何時に起きたんだよ」
「朝の五時には起床しますけど、なにか？」

「………………」
　……さすがだ。
そんな早くに起きて何をするかはわからないが、もう反論のしようもないほど完璧な起床時間である。
lines.label: s304
lines.maoEnglish:
“Oh, thank you. But have you already eaten, Akiha? That looks like after-breakfast tea.”
“Of course. You may rise whenever you please, Brother, but you could at least leave yourself time for breakfast. Eating after seven is proof that you’ve let yourself go.”
“Seven is a perfectly normal time for breakfast. What time did you get up, then?”
“Five in the morning; why?”
“………………”
Of course. I have no idea what she does at that hour, but five is such an unimpeachably perfect answer that I cannot argue with it.

"………"

The worst part is that she’s entirely right, leaving me no room to fight back.

In a human being, perhaps one would call them vital points?

「つまりね、志貴。
　あらゆるモノは“壊れてしまう”という運命を内包しているのよ。

lines.maoEnglish:
They were lines along which a blade could sever anything without the slightest force.
Even something as hard as iron could be cut apart if the blade followed one of those “lines.”
“In other words, Shiki.
Everything carries within it the fate of one day breaking. As long as a thing has form, there is no escaping that condition.”

　子供のころ。
　その意味がようやく理解できて、とても恐くなった記憶がある。
　それはつまり、セカイはツギハギだらけでいつ壊れてもおかしくないという事だ。

地面にもラクガキが走っているのなら。
　そこを歩いていたら、とうとつに地面が砕けてしまうという可能性があるというコト。
―――その意味に気がついた時、心底先生のくれたメガネに感謝した。
lines.label: s51
lines.maoEnglish:
That was what Teach told me.
I was still a child.
I remember how frightened I felt when I finally understood.
It meant the whole world was a patchwork, liable to fall apart at any moment.
Suppose those scribbles ran across the ground as well.
Then the earth might suddenly shatter beneath someone’s feet as they walked over them.
―――When I grasped what that meant, I thanked her from the bottom of my heart for the glasses she had given me.

lines.label: s54
lines.maoEnglish:
“Your school is only a thirty-minute walk from here, isn’t it? Please don’t be late when you live so close. It would be embarrassing.”
“Urgh…”
Every word out of Akiha’s mouth has a barb on it.
The worst part is that she’s entirely right, leaving me no room to fight back.
“Oh, come on—I couldn’t help it. It was so noisy last night that I barely got to sleep.”
“Oh, of course. You only just came home, so you aren’t used to your room yet. Very well—I’ll overlook it today.”
“No, the room wasn’t the problem―――”
The wild dogs had made an incredible racket last night. My strange room had much less to do with my sleeplessness than they did.

「昨夜はよくお眠りになられましたか？
　慣れないお屋敷の夜でしたから、色々と不具合がないかって心配していたんですけど」
「ああ、とりあえず困るようなコトはないよ。
これでも昔はここに住んでいたんだし、今はちゃんと気を配ってくれる琥珀さんがいるし」
「あら。
お上手ですね、志貴さん」
「えっ？
　いや、たんに思ったことを口にしただけど……お上手って、なにが上手なんですか？」
　琥珀さんは笑顔のままこっちを眺めているだけだ。
　……なんていうか、そうまっすぐに見られると照れくさくて、視線をよそに移す。
lines.label: s55
lines.maoEnglish:
“Did you sleep well? It was your first night in an unfamiliar estate, so I was worried something might not suit you.”
“Nothing’s given me any trouble so far. I did live here once, after all—and now I have you looking after me so thoughtfully.”
“My, how smooth of you, Shiki.”
“What? I only said what I was thinking… Smooth at what, exactly?”
Kohaku merely keeps smiling at me.
Having her look at me so directly is embarrassing somehow, and I turn my eyes away.

Apparently she resented both my arriving at this hour and my failure to greet her.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Eight years ago.
The price of recovering from that near-fatal injury was becoming prone to sudden anemia.
When I first left the hospital, it would happen at least once a day.
Collapsing from dizziness became a daily routine for me.
After some time, probably because my body had grown, the spontaneous dizziness and anemia became rarer.
But from time to time, things still trigger dizzy fits, and I still lose consciousness.
Today I was lucky that Arihiko caught me.
Usually, I wind up passed out on the floor.
*sigh*
Taking a slow and deep breath, I draw fresh air into my lungs.
I can feel the blood pooled around the center of my head begin to swirl around again, so I head away from the school.

なら答えは簡単だ。
　俺は、きっと狂ってる。
　おそらくは八年前。
　死亡確定といわれた事故から、奇跡的に蘇生したその時から。
lines.label: s67
lines.maoEnglish:
“Am I insane?”
I didn’t know.
Not a trace remained of the impulse that had possessed me.
But if that feeling returned, what would become of me?
In that moment I hadn’t even tried to resist.
The very idea of restraint had never occurred to me.
『I’ll kill that woman』
If I could accept that thought as naturally as breathing and then carry it out, there was nothing I could do to control myself.
Then the answer was simple.
I had to be insane.
Probably since eight years ago.
Since the moment I miraculously returned from the accident in which I had been declared beyond saving.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: The route-specific passage asks what will happen if the homicidal impulse returns, explains that neither endurance nor even the thought of restraint operated, and concludes that Shiki has no means of controlling it himself. mirror moon stops after the act, deleting the fear that the impulse can recur and that conscious self-control may be impossible.

I was lying to myself.

Cutting her apart had been so thrilling I had nearly come.

Yet I had never even considered it.
I had simply gone on living an ordinary life.
―――If I was dangerous enough to kill something so easily.
Then I should have gouged out these eyes or lived where I would never meet another person.

lines.label: s68

“Tohno―――?”
Without warning.
Someone called that name.

lines.japanese:
「―――――――――」
　顔をあげる。
　そこには――――なんだか、もう何十年ぶりぐらいに思える、先輩の姿があった。
lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
“—” I raised my head.
She stood there—and somehow it felt as
though I hadn’t seen her in decades.

lines.japanese:
「どうしたんですか、こんな雨の中で座り込んじゃって」
「…………あ、め」
　……ああ、なるほど。
　さっきからざあざあとうるさかったノイズは、雨の音、だったのか。
　どうりで寒いはずだ。
　見れば、体中が濡れて冷えきっている。
「もうっ、傘もささないで。
遠野くん、そのままじゃ風邪をひいてしまいますよ」
lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
“What are you doing sitting out here in the rain?”
“Rain.”
Oh, of course.
The static that had been roaring in my ears all this time was rain.
No wonder I was cold.
Looking down, I saw that I was soaked through and chilled to the bone.
“Honestly, not even an umbrella. Tohno, you’ll catch cold like this.”

lines.japanese:
……先輩の声は、すごく、いたい。
　思えばほんの数時間前まで聞いていた声なのに、今ではなんて―――遠くに聞こえる声なんだろう。

「遠野くん？
　わたしの声、聞こえてます……？」
「ん―――ああ、そうだね。
風邪ぐらい、ひいてみても悪くはないかな」
　なにも考えずに、ただそんな言葉だけを返した。
「だめですよ、いくら十月だっていってもこんな雨の中にいたら、風邪ぐらいじゃすまな―――」
　言いながら俺の体に触れて、先輩は言葉を切った。
lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
Ciel’s voice hurt.
I had heard it only a few hours ago, yet now it sounded impossibly far away.
“Tohno? Can you hear me?”
“Mm—yes. Maybe catching a cold wouldn’t be so bad.”
Without thinking, I answer with those words alone.
“Don’t say that—even in October, sitting in rain like this could leave you with far worse than a cold―――”
She touches me and breaks off.

“Tohno, how long have you been out here…? Your body is freezing!”
She caught me by the arm and dragged me to my feet.

「わたしの傘を貸してあげますから早く家に帰って、体をどうにかしてください。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Take my umbrella and go home. Get warm as quickly as you can—your life could truly be in danger.”
“Oh—right. But I can’t go home. I can’t go anywhere anymore.”
Not after what I had done—I couldn’t go home.
There was nowhere left—nowhere in the world where I had any right to rest.

「―――わかりました。

lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
“—” She studied me in silence.
“All right.
Then come to my place. It’s closer than your house, so that works out perfectly.”
She took hold of my arm and pulled me along.
“…”
I couldn’t shake her off.
I was incapable of thought, and her warmth was the one sure thing left in a world where everything else had gone numb.

lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
Ciel’s apartment was one unit in an ordinary two-story building.
It was tiny, with nothing but a kitchenette and a single room of barely ten square meters.
The place was neat in a way that suited her, and that small, familiar detail eased a little of the numbness in my nerves.

lines.maoEnglish:
“—” I had never imagined I would
enter a girl’s room this way.
A girl’s room.
…A woman’s room.
The room of the woman whose home I had
forced my way into before killing her.
“—!”
Nausea rose in me.
What was I doing here?
I had no right to sit in this place and let her care for me.

lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
And then.
Her fingers stop dead.
“Um―――that―――”
She stares at my chest.
“This scar is already healed, isn’t it?”
Oh—the old scar on my chest has startled her.
If you did not know about the burn-like mark in the center of my chest, perhaps it would be alarming.
“It’s fine. That happened eight years ago.”
“I see. Thank goodness—if that wound were the reason you were acting strangely, I’d have to take you to a hospital this instant.”
She gives me a faint, gentle smile.
A sharp ache.
The sight of her smile hurts my chest.

“Oh, you’re done? Then let’s have tea.”
Carrying a tea set, she settled down beside me.
“Sit down, Tohno. If you keep standing there, you’ll make me restless.”
“…”

She poured the tea and handed me a cup.
“—” “…”

My chest hurt.

I was a murderer.
I had no right to her kindness.

“I’m back, Tohno. Thank you for watching the place.”
“―――Ciel.”
She seemed to have bought all sorts of things.
Several plastic bags hung from her hands.

Whatever the reason, if I had killed someone.
Forgetting the person I had killed would be a sin beyond measure.

「そんなの簡単にわかりますよ。
さっきですね、わたしちょっと感動しました。
遠野くん、胸にすごい傷があるでしょ？」
「え……？
　あるけど、それがどうかした？」
「あれだけの傷跡ということは、とても大きな事故だったんでしょう。
……爪あとというものはココロを歪ませます。
あんなに大きな、しかもまだ消えない傷だなんて、ちょっと普通じゃないですよね。
lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
“I don’t understand. I’m a terrible person. I’m not nearly as good as you think.”
“That’s easy enough to see. Earlier, I was actually rather moved. You have an enormous scar on your chest, don’t you?”
“Yes… but what about it?”
“A scar like that must have come from a terrible accident. Such wounds leave marks on the heart as well. One that large, one that still hasn’t faded, is hardly ordinary.

「けど遠野くんはとても自然です。
あんな傷のある人が普通に生きていたという強さは、間違いなく誇れることです。
遠野くんはきっと、とてもまっすぐな幼年期を過ごしたんでしょうね」
　満足そうに呟いたきり、先輩は何も話さなくなった。
　耳をすませば穏やかな寝息が聞こえてくる。
「……寝ちゃったのか、先輩」
　返事はない。
　ただ、外からはざあ、という雨だれの音だけが聞こえてくる。
lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yet you’re perfectly ordinary. The strength it took for someone with a scar like that to go on living a normal life is unquestionably something to be proud of. You must have had a very honest, wholesome childhood.”
After murmuring that with satisfaction, she fell silent.
When I listened closely, I could hear her slow, peaceful breathing.
“Did you fall asleep, Ciel?”
There was no answer.
Only the steady sound of rain beyond the room.

lines.japanese:
「………償い、か」
　犯した罪に相当する罰。
　明日になれば俺に殺された彼女の死体が発見されて、新しい猟奇殺人としてニュースで報道されるのだろうか。
　そうなった時、俺が失うものはそれこそ数えきれないだろう。
　秋葉には迷惑をかけるだろうし、こうやって先輩と話をする事も二度と出来なくなる。
「…………………」
lines.label: s68
lines.maoEnglish:
“Atonement.”
A punishment equal to the crime.
Would the body of the woman I had killed be discovered tomorrow and reported as the latest grotesque murder?
When that happened, the things I would lose were beyond counting.
I would bring disgrace and trouble to Akiha, and I would never again be able to talk with Ciel like this.
“…………………”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Are you asleep, Senpai?"
There is no reply.
I can only hear the sound of the rain from outside.
"…… Atone for my sins, huh?"
A punishment to fit the sin I had committed.
I guess they'll find the body of the girl I had killed tomorrow, and there'll be a new serial killer story on the news.
I can't even begin to count the things I'll lose when that happens.
It'll be trouble for Akiha for sure, and I'll never be able to talk to Senpai like this again.
"…………"

lines.maoEnglish:
But if accepting all that could become atonement, then I had no choice but to accept it.
If it could atone for what I had done, then perhaps something resembling salvation did exist somewhere.

I was beginning to feel sleepy.
I didn’t know what tomorrow would bring.
But if I was allowed even this much.
Until the moment my crime was discovered and I was called to answer for it.
I wanted to go on living this life.
